_doc: Issue 1372 part B: the ONE canonical dantesync config.json per ROLE. scripts/dantesync-config-drift.sh
reads every fleet node's config (scripts/lib/dantesync-fleet.sh) and scripts/dantesync_fleet.py
compares it with its role's template here and prints a named diff. Report-only: nothing writes a
config to a box from this file. Changing a role's policy (e.g. phase_slew, the dantesync#117
role contract) is an edit here plus a separate, deliberate roll-out.
Every leaf of a template must match the node. Keys starting with '_' are comments on both sides.
A node key the template does not have is reported as an extra key.
Value tokens: '@video_gm' = the rig grandmaster name (scripts/lib/rig-grandmaster.sh,
{"$optional": V} = the key may be absent, but when present it must equal V (the camboxes pass
ntp_server on the unit's --ntp-server command line, so their config has no ntp_server key).
{"$any": true} = the key must be present; any value is accepted.
